name: Google Books API
tagline: Search and access book metadata, previews, and volume data from Google Books
description: The Google Books API lets developers search the Google Books catalog, retrieve volume metadata (title, authors, ISBN, description, covers), and access user library data. It supports volume search, volume lookups by ID, and authenticated access to a user's bookshelves. Commonly used for book discovery apps, library tools, reading list features, and ISBN lookup.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY for public data; OAuth 2.0 required for user library/bookshelves. Create credentials in Google Cloud Console.

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — confirm on Google Cloud quotas
pricing.paid_plans: Google Cloud billing may apply above free quotas

rate_limits: not published — check Google Cloud Console quotas
use_cases: search books by title, author, or ISBN
look up volume metadata and cover images by book ID
build reading lists or library catalog features
